prompt: A well-lit presenter faces the locked camera in a silent studio and says <d>[English] Fast video and clear audio arrive together.</d> No music or background noise.
expected_audio: Exact English sentence, clean voice, synchronized lips.

prompt: A woman at a quiet kitchen table looks into the camera and says <d>[Spanish] El vaso está lleno de agua fría.</d> No music plays.
expected_audio: Exact intelligible Spanish sentence with synchronized lips.

prompt: A man stands in a quiet library and says <d>[Chinese] 今天的天气非常晴朗。</d> Static close shot, no music.
expected_audio: Exact intelligible Mandarin sentence with synchronized lips.

prompt: A woman at a train platform faces the camera and says <d>[Japanese] 次の電車は三時に来ます。</d> The distant station remains quiet, with no music.
expected_audio: Exact intelligible Japanese sentence with synchronized lips.

prompt: Two singers perform a gentle acoustic duet on a small stage, trading one line each and then harmonizing. One guitar accompanies them; the audience stays quiet.
expected_audio: Two distinct singing voices, stable harmony, and clean acoustic guitar.

prompt: Close view of a violinist performing a slow lyrical melody in a dry rehearsal room. Bow direction and note attacks remain visible. No other instruments.
expected_audio: Natural solo violin whose attacks follow the visible bow changes.

prompt: A drummer plays four measured hits: kick, snare, kick, then cymbal, with a clear pause between each. Locked front camera, no backing track.
expected_audio: Exactly four distinct percussion events aligned with the visible strikes.

prompt: Overhead close-up of two hands playing a rising eight-note piano scale, then stopping with both hands lifted. No speech and no room chatter.
expected_audio: Eight clean rising piano notes that stop when the hands lift.

prompt: Extreme close-up of hands slowly folding crisp paper twice and tearing it once along the crease. Quiet room, no speech, no music.
expected_audio: Two soft folds followed by one crisp synchronized tear.

prompt: Close-up of a chef making six evenly spaced knife cuts through a carrot on a wooden board, then placing the knife down. No music.
expected_audio: Six dry synchronized chopping impacts and one softer knife placement.

prompt: Low tracking shot of boots taking five slow steps across loose gravel and stopping. Wind is very faint; no speech or music.
expected_audio: Five granular footstep crunches aligned to heel contact, then silence.

prompt: Close-up of a person slowly zipping a canvas backpack, tightening one strap, and setting it on a table. Quiet indoor room.
expected_audio: Continuous zipper texture, brief fabric pull, and one soft table thump.

prompt: A red balloon floats motionless. A visible pin touches it at exactly the middle of the shot and the balloon bursts once. Static camera, no music.
expected_audio: One sharp pop exactly at visible rupture, with silence before and after.

prompt: Side view of a basketball dropped onto a gym floor. It bounces exactly three times, each bounce lower than the last, then rolls away.
expected_audio: Three decreasing synchronized bounces followed by a quiet rolling sound.

prompt: A hand turns a brass handle, opens a wooden door, and closes it until the latch clicks. The camera stays on the handle; no speech or music.
expected_audio: Handle turn, hinge movement, closing thump, and final click aligned to motion.

prompt: Night skyline with one firework launching, bursting once into a blue circle, and fading. No crowd and no background music.
expected_audio: Launch whistle followed by one delayed boom, with no extra explosions.

prompt: A silent locked portrait of a sleeping cat in a sunlit room. Only subtle breathing and curtain movement; explicitly no speech, music, buzzing, or hiss.
expected_audio: Near-silence without synthetic hiss or unexpected events.

prompt: Wide static view of fresh snow falling over an empty field at dawn. No people, vehicles, animals, speech, or music.
expected_audio: Very quiet natural ambience without voices, tones, or crackle.

prompt: Continuous close-up of rain striking a window while distant traffic lights blur outside. The rainfall remains steady and no one speaks.
expected_audio: Stable natural rain texture with faint distant traffic and no artifacts.

prompt: Wide sunset beach view as three waves reach the shore in succession and foam recedes. Slow tripod pan, no people and no music.
expected_audio: Three broad wave surges synchronized to shore contact, then receding foam.

prompt: A motorcycle accelerates along a wet coastal road while the camera tracks beside it at speed. Water sprays from the tires and the engine pitch rises in stereo.
expected_audio: Engine pitch and tire spray synchronized to acceleration and motion.

prompt: A dog sprints across grass, leaps to catch a flying frisbee, lands, and runs back toward the camera in one continuous tracking shot.
expected_audio: Footfalls, one brief jump effort, landing impact, and natural outdoor ambience.

prompt: First, a wide view of a steam train entering a rural station with rhythmic wheel sounds; then a clean cut to the conductor opening a carriage door as steam hisses.
expected_audio: Wheel rhythm before the cut and close steam hiss after it, with perspective change.

prompt: Three-shot sequence in one cafe: espresso pours into a cup, milk is steamed, then the finished cup is set beside a customer. Each cut changes audio perspective naturally.
expected_audio: Pour, steam, and cup placement in the correct shots without carryover artifacts.
